What metrics would actually show true sectoral adaptability: falling per-unit fuel use, rising efficiency, or just unchanged totals?  
Could steady consumption be masking deeper vulnerabilities, like deferred maintenance or hidden cost shifts onto ratepayers?  
Is the real story not about resilience at all, but about who’s being forced to absorb stagnation while policymakers delay reform?
